blocks.text: Yeh chapter 18 (Transition Metals) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are transition metals? How are they classified, and what are first row transition elements? Mention the importance of these metals in daily life. (4 marks)
(Transition metals kya hain? Inhein kaise baanta jata hai aur pehli row ke transition elements kya hain? Rozmarra zindagi mein in ki ahmiyat bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Transition metals modern periodic table ke d aur f blocks mein milte hain. In ki pehchaan zyada density, conductivity aur rangeen compounds banane ki salahiyat hai.

Darja-bandi (electronic configuration ki buniyaad par):
• d-block: bahar wale electrons d-orbitals mein bhar rahe hon.
• f-block: bahar wale electrons f-orbitals mein bhar rahe hon.

Pehli row ke transition elements (3d series): d block ke woh elements jin ki kisi bhi stable oxidation state mein d-orbitals adhoore bhare hon. Inhein transition elements is liye kehte hain ke yeh mukhtalif oxidation states ke darmiyan tabdeel hote hain. d-block groups 3 se 12 tak hai, magar zinc aur scandium transition elements nahi; Zn sirf Zn²⁺, [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s⁰, banata hai jis ka 3d subshell poora hai.

Ahmiyat: iron insani tehzeeb ki reerh ki haddi hai; industrial revolution se mazboot auzaar aur steel is se bane. Copper, silver aur gold sikkon aur zevraat mein istemal hue aur aaj corrosion resistance (zang se bachao) aur conductivity ki wajah se electronics aur dentistry mein zaroori hain.

book_ref.quote: The transition metals can be classified on the basis of their electronic configuration into d-block

blocks.prompt:
2 Write the electronic configurations of the first row transition elements Ti to Cu in their M⁰, M²⁺ and M³⁺ states. Explain why chromium and copper show anomalous configurations. (4 marks)
(Pehli row ke transition elements Ti se Cu ki M⁰, M²⁺ aur M³⁺ states mein electronic configurations likhein. Chromium aur copper ki be-qaida configurations ki wajah bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Configurations (Table 18.1) yeh hain:

Cr aur Cu ki be-qaidagi: configurations aam taur par Aufbau principle par chalti hain siwaye chromium aur copper ke. Cr 3d⁵4s¹ (3d⁴4s² nahi) hai taake aadhe bhare d-subshell ki stability mile, aur Cu 3d¹⁰4s¹ (3d⁹4s² nahi) hai taake poore bhare d-subshell ki stability mile. Yeh asar electron cloud ko zyada symmetrical banata hai aur nucleus ko behtar shielding deta hai.

Ions mein pehle 4s electrons nikalte hain: har M²⁺ [Ar] 3dⁿ4s⁰ hai, aur M³⁺ mein aik 3d electron aur kam hai.

book_ref.quote: Electronic configuration of the transition elements usually follows Aufbau principle, except in chromium and copper.

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the physical properties of the first row transition elements, giving reasons where the chapter explains a trend. (4 marks)
(Pehli row ke transition elements ki physical properties bayan karein, aur jahan chapter trend ki wajah batata hai woh bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Pehli row ke transition elements (titanium se copper) adhoore bhare 3d orbitals ki wajah se yeh physical properties dikhate hain:
1. Yeh sakht aur mazboot solids hain; sab chamakdar chandi jaise ya grey hain siwaye copper ke jo surkhi maail bhoora hai.
2. Atomic radius aam taur par left se right kam hota hai magar aakhir mein thora barhta hai; is ka ta'alluq copper ke poore bhare d-subshell ki stability se hai.
3. In ke melting aur boiling points zyada hain aur left se right badalte trend mein hain (Figure 18.1).
4. Yeh bijli aur garmi ke ache conductors hain.
5. In ki densities zyada hain aur titanium se copper tak barhti hain, nuclear charge ke baqaida izafe aur atomic size ke sukarne ki wajah se.
6. In ki surface chamakdar hai aur yeh malleable (patli chaadar) aur ductile (taar) hain.
7. Aksar yeh aur in ke compounds un-paired d electrons ki wajah se paramagnetic hain.

book_ref.quote: They have high densities that generally increase across the row from titanium to copper.

blocks.prompt:
4 State the chemical properties of transition metals. Explain why they form complexes and coloured compounds. (4 marks)
(Transition metals ki chemical properties likhein. Yeh complexes aur rangeen compounds kyun banate hain, wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Transition metals ki chemical properties:
1. Mukhtalif oxidation states: yeh mukhtalif tadaad mein electrons kho kar stable ions banate hain, maslan Fe²⁺ aur Fe³⁺.
2. Complex banana: yeh ligands ke lone pairs ko apne khaali d-orbitals mein le kar coordination compounds banate hain.
3. Rangeen ions aur complexes: roshni jazb karke electrons kam se zyada energy level par jate hain; jazb na hone wali roshni rang deti hai.
4. Catalyst ka kaam: yeh asaani se oxidation state badalte hain is liye catalysts hain.

Complexes kyun: khaali d orbitals ki energy itni kam hai ke yeh H₂O, NH₃ ya Cl⁻ jaise ligands se electron pairs le sakte hain aur coordinate (dative) bonds bante hain.
Rang kyun: complex mein d orbitals do sets mein bat jate hain; munasib energy ki roshni electron ko neeche se upar wale set mein le jati hai (d-d transition) aur complementary rang nazar aata hai.

book_ref.quote: These metals and their compounds behave as catalysts because they can easily change oxidation states.

blocks.prompt:
5 Explain the variable oxidation states of 3d elements with reference to Table 18.2. Why does manganese reach +7 in MnO₄⁻? (4 marks)
(Table 18.2 ke hawale se 3d elements ki mukhtalif oxidation states wazeh karein. Manganese MnO₄⁻ mein +7 tak kyun pohanchta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Wajah: 3d aur 4s subshells ki energy taqreeban barabar hai; andar wale 3d aur bahar wale 4s ka energy farq bohat kam hai. Is liye 4s ki tarah 3d electrons bhi asaani se nikal jate hain aur dono chemical bonding mein hissa lete hain.

3d metal atom kho sakta hai:
• sirf 4s electrons, jis se aam +2 oxidation state banti hai;
• 4s ke saath kuch 3d electrons, jis se unchi oxidation states banti hain.

Trend (Table 18.2): +2 Ti se Cu tak sab mein hai; sab se unchi state row ke darmiyan tak barhti aur phir ghatti hai, yani left se right parabolic trend. Mn ki sab se zyada oxidation state +7 hai.

MnO₄⁻ mein Mn: x + 4(−2) = −1, is liye x = +7. Mn [Ar] 3d⁵4s² hai; dono 4s aur paanchon 3d electrons (kul 7) khone se +7 state banti hai.

book_ref.quote: First row transition elements show variable oxidation states because the 3d and 4s subshells have comparable

blocks.prompt:
6 Explain the two ways in which transition metals and their compounds act as catalysts, giving one example of each. (4 marks)
(Transition metals aur un ke compounds jin do tareeqon se catalyst ka kaam karte hain un ki wazahat karein aur har aik ki aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Oxidation states badal kar (aam taur par homogeneous catalysis): transition metal ions asaani se stable oxidation states badalte hain (maslan Fe²⁺ ⇌ Fe³⁺). Is se metal ion reactant molecule ke saath unstable intermediate compound banata hai. Intermediate jaldi product banata hai aur catalyst apni asal oxidation state mein wapas aa jata hai. Is tarah kam activation energy wala raasta milta hai.
Misaal: acetylene se acrylic acid banane mein nickel salts, jin mein Ni(0) aur Ni(II) states shamil hain.

2. Khaali d-orbitals se surface ka amal (aam taur par heterogeneous catalysis): qabil-e-rasai khaali d-orbitals ki wajah se reactant molecules catalyst surface se jur kar aarzi activated complex banate hain. Yeh reactants ko durust orientation mein pakarta hai aur activation energy kam karta hai. Reaction ke baad products alag (desorb) hote hain aur catalyst agle cycle ke liye tayyar hota hai.
Misaal: Haber process mein solid iron nitrogen aur hydrogen se ammonia banne ko tez karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Another characteristic of transition metals is their vacant d-orbitals that are energetically accessible.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is a ligand? Classify ligands (i) on the basis of their charge and (ii) on the basis of the number of electron pairs donated, with examples. (4 marks)
(Ligand kya hai? Ligands ki darja-bandi (i) charge ki buniyaad par aur (ii) diye gaye electron pairs ki tadaad ki buniyaad par misaalon ke saath karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ligand: woh molecule ya ion (maslan H₂O, NH₃, Cl⁻) jis ke paas kam az kam aik lone pair ho aur jo markazi metal atom ya ion se coordinate (dative) bond banaye. Yeh Lewis base hai. Lafz Latin 'ligare' yani 'baandhna' se hai.

(i) Charge ki buniyaad par:
• Anionic ligands: manfi charge wale, sab se zyada, maslan Cl⁻, CN⁻, OH⁻, C₂O₄²⁻; naam '-o' par (chloro, cyano).
• Neutral ligands: be-charge molecules, maslan H₂O, NH₃, CO; naam aam taur par wohi, magar H₂O aqua, NH₃ ammine aur CO carbonyl.
• Cationic ligands: musbat charge wale, kam milte hain, naam '-ium' par, maslan NO⁺ (nitrosonium), NH₂–NH₃⁺ (hydrazinium).

(ii) Electron pairs ki tadaad par:
• Monodentate: aik atom se aik pair deta hai, maslan H₂O, NH₃, CO, Cl⁻, OH⁻, CN⁻.
• Bidentate: do pairs deta hai, maslan 1,2-diaminoethane (en, H₂NCH₂CH₂NH₂) apne do N atoms se, aur ethanedioate (C₂O₄²⁻) do O atoms se, har carboxyl group se aik.
• Polydentate: do se zyada dative bonds banata hai, maslan EDTA jo hexadentate hai (chaar O aur do N donor atoms).

book_ref.quote: Ligands can be classified into different categories.

blocks.prompt:
8 Using the hexacyanoferrate(II) ion [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻, explain the terms central metal ion, ligand, coordination number, coordination sphere and charge on the sphere. (4 marks)
(Hexacyanoferrate(II) ion [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ ki misaal se central metal ion, ligand, coordination number, coordination sphere aur sphere par charge ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Metal complex woh molecule ya ion hai jo markazi metal atom ya ion ke gird electron dene wali species se banta hai. [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ mein (Figure 18.2):

• Central metal ion: Fe²⁺, jo Lewis acid hai; is ke khaali d orbitals electron pairs lete hain.
• Ligands: chhe CN⁻ ions (cyano), jo Lewis bases hain aur lone pairs de kar coordinate (dative) bonds banate hain.
• Coordination number: ligands aur metal ke darmiyan kul dative bonds = 6. Yeh poora structure tay karta hai (yahan octahedral).
• Coordination sphere: markazi ion aur us se seedha jure ligands, square brackets mein, [Fe(CN)₆].
• Sphere par charge: metal ion aur ligands ke charges ka jama = (+2) + 6 × (−1) = +2 − 6 = −4. Ligands ka kul charge −6 hai.
Ulta, metal ka charge = sphere ka charge − ligands ka kul charge = (−4) − (−6) = +2.

book_ref.quote: A metal complex (or coordination compound) is a molecule or ion that forms when a central metal atom or ion is surrounded

blocks.prompt:
9 Predict the formula, overall charge and coordination number of the complex ions formed by (i) Cu²⁺ with four Cl⁻ ligands, (ii) Ag⁺ with two CN⁻ ligands, (iii) Fe³⁺ with three bidentate C₂O₄²⁻ ligands. Also find the oxidation state of Co in [Co(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]³⁺. (4 marks)
(In se banne wale complex ions ka formula, kul charge aur coordination number batayein: (i) Cu²⁺ aur chaar Cl⁻ ligands, (ii) Ag⁺ aur do CN⁻ ligands, (iii) Fe³⁺ aur teen bidentate C₂O₄²⁻ ligands. [Co(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]³⁺ mein Co ki oxidation state bhi nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: [M(L)ₓ]±ʸ likhein: kul charge = metal ka charge + (ligands ki tadaad × ligand ka charge); coordination number = dative bonds ki tadaad.

book_ref.quote: The formula and charge of a complex ion are determined by combining the central metal ion, its oxidation state, and the ligands

steps: (i) Charge = (+2) + 4 × (−1) = −2 → [CuCl₄]²⁻; chaar monodentate Cl⁻, coordination number 4.
(iii) Charge = (+3) + 3 × (−2) = −3 → [Fe(C₂O₄)₃]³⁻; har C₂O₄²⁻ 2 bonds banata hai, coordination number 3 × 2 = 6.
Co: x + 4(0) + 2(0) = +3, kyun ke NH₃ aur H₂O neutral hain, is liye x = +3.

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the linear, square planar, tetrahedral and octahedral geometries of transition metal complexes, giving the bond angles and examples. (4 marks)
(Transition metal complexes ki linear, square planar, tetrahedral aur octahedral geometries bond angles aur misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Transition metal complexes ki shaklein metal ki electronic configuration, coordination number aur ligands ki fitrat par munhasir hain (Figure 18.3):

• Linear (do ligands): do ligands metal ion ke aamne saamne 180° par.
• Square planar (chaar ligands): metal ion aur chaar ligands aik plane mein square ke konon par, bond angle 90°; d⁸ ions jaise Ni²⁺ aur Pt²⁺ ki khaasiyat.
• Tetrahedral (chaar ligands): ligands tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf, bond angle 109.5°.
• Octahedral (chhe ligands): ligands x, y aur z axes par; chaar 90° par square plane banate hain aur do us ke upar neeche 180° par. Yeh sab se aam geometry hai.

book_ref.quote: The common geometries found in transition metal complexes are explained below:

blocks.prompt:
11 How does the nature of the ligand affect the d-orbital splitting ΔE and the colour of a complex? Write the order of ligands from high to low ΔE. (4 marks)
(Ligand ki fitrat d-orbital splitting ΔE aur complex ke rang par kaise asar karti hai? Ligands ki zyada se kam ΔE ki tarteeb likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Splitting: akele atom mein paanch d orbitals degenerate hain. Qareeb aate ligands electric field banate hain jo inhein do mukhtalif energy sets mein baant deta hai; energy ka farq ΔE hai.

Ligand ka asar:
• Kuch ligands jaise NH₃ aur CN⁻ zyada splitting (bara ΔE) dete hain; kuch jaise Cl⁻ aur I⁻ kam ΔE dete hain.
• d orbitals ko baantne ki salahiyat ki tarteeb (zyada se kam ΔE): CN⁻ > en > NH₃ > H₂O > OH⁻ > Cl⁻ > Br⁻ > I⁻.

Rang par asar:
• Bare ΔE ke liye zyada frequency (chhoti wavelength) ki violet ya neeli roshni jazb hoti hai; peeli roshni wapas aati hai aur compound peela nazar aata hai.
• Chhote ΔE wale complexes kam energy ki (laal/narangi) roshni jazb karke neele ya sabz nazar aate hain, complementary rang ke usool se.
Is tarah ligand badalne se ΔE, jazb frequency aur nazar aane wala rang badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The nature of the ligand affects the magnitude of the splitting, ΔE.

blocks.prompt:
12 A complex absorbs light of wavelength 550 nm in a d-d transition. Calculate (i) the frequency of the light, (ii) the energy ΔE of one transition, (iii) ΔE per mole. (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, Nᴀ = 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(Aik complex d-d transition mein 550 nm wavelength ki roshni jazb karta hai. Nikalein: (i) roshni ki frequency, (ii) aik transition ki energy ΔE, (iii) fi mole ΔE. (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, Nᴀ = 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Planck ki equation ΔE = hν = hc/λ lagayein, λ metres mein; aik mole ke liye Nᴀ se zarab dein.

book_ref.quote: The energy required for a d-d transition, corresponds to a specific frequency (ν) and wavelength (λ) of visible light

steps: (iii) Fi mole ΔE = 3.62 × 10⁻¹⁹ × 6.02 × 10²³ = 2.18 × 10⁵ J mol⁻¹ = 218 kJ mol⁻¹.
blocks.final_answer: ν = 5.45 × 10¹⁴ s⁻¹; ΔE = 3.62 × 10⁻¹⁹ J fi transition = 218 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain how transition metal complexes show colour. What is a d-d transition, and how is the colour seen related to the light absorbed? (4 marks)
(Transition metal complexes rang kaise dikhate hain? d-d transition kya hai aur nazar aane wala rang jazb shuda roshni se kaise juda hai?)

book_ref.quote: When white light falls on the compound, it may get absorbed completely, and the complex appears black.

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the ligand exchange reactions of aqueous copper(II) ions with sodium hydroxide and with ammonia. Give equations and colour changes. (4 marks)
(Aqueous copper(II) ions ke sodium hydroxide aur ammonia ke saath ligand exchange reactions bayan karein. Equations aur rang ki tabdeeliyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Cu²⁺(aq) asal mein complex ion [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ hai jo copper sulphate jaise copper(II) salts ke solution ko neela rang deta hai.

1. Sodium hydroxide ke saath: do paani ligands do hydroxide ions se badalte hain aur halka neela precipitate banta hai:
[Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺(aq) (neela) + 2OH⁻(aq) → [Cu(H₂O)₄(OH)₂](s) (halka neela ppt) + 2H₂O(l)

2. Concentrated ammonia ke saath: halka neela precipitate ghul jata hai aur [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺ ka gehra neela solution banta hai (Figure 18.7).

3. Ammonia se seedhi tabdeeli: [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ ke chaar paani molecules ammonia se badalte hain:
[Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺(aq) + 4NH₃(aq) → [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺(aq) + 4H₂O(l)
Asaani ke liye product ko [Cu(NH₃)₄]²⁺ likha jata hai. Naya complex zyada stable hai, is liye tabdeeli hoti hai aur rang neele se gehra neela ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: If concentrated ammonia solution is added, the light blue precipitate dissolves resulting in a dark blue solution.

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe the ligand exchange reactions of aqueous cobalt(II) ions with sodium hydroxide and with ammonia. Give equations and colour changes. (4 marks)
(Aqueous cobalt(II) ions ke sodium hydroxide aur ammonia ke saath ligand exchange reactions bayan karein. Equations aur rang ki tabdeeliyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Co²⁺(aq) complex ion [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ hai jo cobalt(II) sulphate ke solution ko gulabi rang deta hai.

1. Sodium hydroxide ke saath: cobalt(II) hydroxide ka neela precipitate banta hai jo rakhne par gulabi ho sakta hai:
[Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺(aq) (gulabi) + 2OH⁻(aq) → [Co(H₂O)₄(OH)₂](s) (neela ppt) + 2H₂O(l)

2. Precipitate par zyada ammonia: ammonia ligands paani aur hydroxide ki jagah le kar ghulnashil hexaamminecobalt(II) ion banate hain; solution peela ho jata hai (Figure 18.9):
[Co(H₂O)₄(OH)₂](s) + 6NH₃(aq) → [Co(NH₃)₆]²⁺(aq) (peela) + 4H₂O(l) + 2OH⁻(aq)

3. Concentrated ammonia se seedhi tabdeeli:
[Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺(aq) + 6NH₃(aq) → [Co(NH₃)₆]²⁺(aq) + 6H₂O(l)
Ammine complex aqua complex se zyada stable hai, is liye paani ligands badal jate hain.

book_ref.quote: When excess ammonia solution is added to the cobalt(II) hydroxide precipitate, a ligand exchange reaction takes place.

blocks.prompt:
16 Explain the effect of ligand exchange on the colour of complexes, using the copper(II) and cobalt(II) examples of Table 18.4. (4 marks)
(Table 18.4 ki copper(II) aur cobalt(II) misaalon se complexes ke rang par ligand exchange ka asar wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Agar banne wala naya complex zyada stable ho to ligands badal jate hain aur complex ki properties jaise rang, structure aur reactivity badalti hain.

Rang kyun badalta hai: ligands badalne se metal ion ki d-orbital splitting ki miqdaar badalti hai. Naye ligands (NH₃ ya Cl⁻) H₂O se zyada stable complex banate hain aur ΔE mukhtalif hota hai. Is liye mukhtalif frequency ki roshni jazb hoti hai aur rang badal jata hai.

Misaalein (Table 18.4):

book_ref.quote: In each case, the new complex has a different ΔE because the new ligands

blocks.prompt:
17 What is the stability constant Kstab? Write its expression for the formation of [CuCl₄]²⁻ and explain how log₁₀ Kstab values are used to compare complexes and predict ligand displacement. (4 marks)
(Stability constant Kstab kya hai? [CuCl₄]²⁻ banne ke liye is ka expression likhein aur wazeh karein ke log₁₀ Kstab se complexes ka muqabla aur ligand ki tabdeeli ki pesh-goi kaise hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Kstab complex ion banne ka equilibrium constant (Kc) hai. Paani mein H₂O pehla ligand hai aur naya ligand metal ion ke liye us se muqabla karta hai:
[Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻(aq) ⇌ [CuCl₄]²⁻(aq) + 6H₂O(l)
Kstab = [CuCl₄²⁻] ÷ ([Cu(H₂O)₆²⁺][Cl⁻]⁴)
[H₂O] nikal diya jata hai kyun ke paani solvent hai aur is ka concentration constant rehta hai.

log₁₀ Kstab ka istemal: bohat bari qeematon ka muqabla asaan karne ke liye log₁₀ scale istemal hota hai. Zyada log₁₀ Kstab ka matlab zyada stable complex aur equilibrium bohat right par; kam qeemat ka matlab kam stable complex jis ke ligands asaani se hat jate hain. Table 18.5: [CuCl₄]²⁻ 5.6, ammonia complex [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺ 13.1, [Cu(EDTA)]²⁻ 18.8.

Chelating effect: polydentate ligands (EDTA) wale complexes ka Kstab monodentate walon se zyada hai, maslan [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺(aq) + 3en → [Cu(en)₃]²⁺(aq) + 6H₂O(l).

Tabdeeli: zyada Kstab wala ligand kam Kstab wale ko hata deta hai. Chloride complex mein ammonia dalne se solution neela ho jata hai:
[CuCl₄]²⁻(aq) + 4NH₃(aq) + 2H₂O(l) → [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺(aq) + 4Cl⁻(aq)
Complex ko bohat zyada paani se patla karne par equilibrium wapas left ko ja sakta hai aur hydrated ion dobara banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Let us take the example of following equilibrium complexation reaction with its Kstab expression;

blocks.prompt:
18 For [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻ ⇌ [CuCl₄]²⁻ + 6H₂O, an equilibrium mixture contains [Cu(H₂O)₆²⁺] = 2.0 × 10⁻⁶, [Cl⁻] = 0.50 and [CuCl₄²⁻] = 0.050 mol dm⁻³. (i) Calculate Kstab and log₁₀ Kstab. (ii) Find the ratio [CuCl₄²⁻] ÷ [Cu(H₂O)₆²⁺] when the solution is diluted so that [Cl⁻] = 0.010 mol dm⁻³, and comment. (4 marks)
([Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻ ⇌ [CuCl₄]²⁻ + 6H₂O ke equilibrium mixture mein [Cu(H₂O)₆²⁺] = 2.0 × 10⁻⁶, [Cl⁻] = 0.50 aur [CuCl₄²⁻] = 0.050 mol dm⁻³ hain. (i) Kstab aur log₁₀ Kstab nikalein. (ii) Solution ko itna patla karein ke [Cl⁻] = 0.010 mol dm⁻³ ho jaye to [CuCl₄²⁻] ÷ [Cu(H₂O)₆²⁺] ka ratio nikalein aur tabsira karein.)
blocks.explanation: Equilibrium concentrations ko Kstab = [CuCl₄²⁻] ÷ ([Cu(H₂O)₆²⁺][Cl⁻]⁴) mein rakhein (paani ke baghair); phir ratio = Kstab × [Cl⁻]⁴.

book_ref.quote: Similarly, if a stable complex is diluted with a massive amount of water

steps: log₁₀ Kstab = log₁₀(4.0 × 10⁵) = 5.6 (Table 18.5 mein [CuCl₄]²⁻ ki qeemat).
Ratio 0.050 ÷ 2.0 × 10⁻⁶ = 2.5 × 10⁴ se gir kar 4.0 × 10⁻³ ho jata hai: bohat patla karne par equilibrium wapas left ko jata hai aur hydrated ion [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ dobara banta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Kstab = 4.0 × 10⁵ (log₁₀ Kstab = 5.6); patla karne ke baad ratio 4.0 × 10⁻³, yani hydrated ion dobara banta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kstab constant rehta hai, magar ratio [Cl⁻]⁴ par munhasir hai. [Cl⁻] 50 guna kam ho to [Cl⁻]⁴ 50⁴ = 6.25 × 10⁶ guna kam hota hai, is liye [CuCl₄]²⁻ tez se toot jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
19 Explain geometrical (cis-trans) isomerism in square planar and octahedral complexes, using [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] and [Co(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]³⁺. Why do cisplatin and transplatin differ in polarity and use? (4 marks)
([Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] aur [Co(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]³⁺ ki misaal se square planar aur octahedral complexes mein geometrical (cis-trans) isomerism wazeh karein. Cisplatin aur transplatin polarity aur istemal mein mukhtalif kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Stereoisomers ka formula aur bonds aik jaise magar ligands ki space mein tarteeb mukhtalif hoti hai. Geometrical isomers mein aik jaise ligands saath saath (90°, cis) ya aamne saamne (180°, trans) hote hain. Yeh square planar aur octahedral complexes mein aam hai.

Square planar [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] (Figure 18.11): cis-[Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] (cisplatin) mein do Cl saath saath 90° par; trans-[Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] (transplatin) mein aamne saamne 180° par.
• Polarity: transplatin mein aik jaise ligands ke bond dipoles ulti simt mein ho kar khatam ho jate hain, is liye nonpolar. Cisplatin mein khatam nahi hote, dipole moment sifar nahi, is liye polar.
• Istemal: cisplatin cancer ki dawa hai, transplatin nahi. Cell ke andar paani is ke chloride ions ki jagah leta hai (ligand exchange); activated dawa DNA ke guanine bases se jur kar cross-links banati hai jo DNA replication rok kar programmed cell death (apoptosis) shuru karte hain.

Octahedral [Co(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]³⁺, aik [MA₄B₂] complex (Figure 18.12), ke sirf do geometrical isomers hain: cis, jis mein do H₂O 90° par, aur trans, jis mein 180° par.

book_ref.quote: In transplatin, the individual bond dipoles of the identical ligands are pointed in opposite direction

blocks.prompt:
20 What are optical isomers? Explain optical isomerism in [Ni(en)₃]²⁺ and compare optical isomerism with geometrical isomerism. (4 marks)
(Optical isomers kya hain? [Ni(en)₃]²⁺ mein optical isomerism wazeh karein aur optical isomerism ka geometrical isomerism se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Optical isomers aik doosre ki aisi mirror images hain jo aik doosre par poori nahi baithtin. Optical isomerism aam taur par bidentate ligands wale octahedral complexes dikhate hain.

[Ni(en)₃]²⁺: nickel(II) teen bidentate 1,2-diaminoethane (NH₂CH₂CH₂NH₂) ligands se octahedral tarteeb mein jura hai (Figure 18.13). Do shaklein aisi mirror images hain jo superimpose nahi hotin, is liye optical isomers hain; aise jore ko enantiomers kehte hain. Yeh polarized light ka plane ulti simton mein ghumate hain: right ghumane wala dextrorotatory (+), left ghumane wala laevorotatory (–).

Muqabla:

book_ref.quote: The isomer that rotates the plane in right hand direction is called dextrorotatory

rows: Aik jaise ligands saath saath (90°) ya aamne saamne (180°)
Square planar aur octahedral complexes mein aam
Bidentate ligands wale octahedral complexes mein aam
Isomers ki properties jaise polarity mukhtalif
Enantiomers polarized light ko ulti simton mein ghumate hain

blocks.prompt:
21 Acidified MnO₄⁻ oxidizes ethanedioate ions (E°: MnO₄⁻/Mn²⁺ = +1.52 V; 2CO₂/C₂O₄²⁻ = −0.49 V). (i) Write the balanced ionic equation and calculate E°cell. (ii) 20.0 cm³ of 0.0600 mol dm⁻³ C₂O₄²⁻ solution is titrated with 0.0160 mol dm⁻³ KMnO₄ in acid. Find the volume of KMnO₄ needed and the moles of CO₂ formed. (4 marks)
(Acidified MnO₄⁻ ethanedioate ions ko oxidize karta hai (E°: MnO₄⁻/Mn²⁺ = +1.52 V; 2CO₂/C₂O₄²⁻ = −0.49 V). (i) Balanced ionic equation likhein aur E°cell nikalein. (ii) 20.0 cm³ 0.0600 mol dm⁻³ C₂O₄²⁻ solution ko acid mein 0.0160 mol dm⁻³ KMnO₄ se titrate kiya jata hai. KMnO₄ ka volume aur banne wali CO₂ ke moles nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Zyada musbat E° (MnO₄⁻) reduce hota hai; electrons barabar karein (5e⁻ × 2 = 2e⁻ × 5 = 10e⁻), E°cell = E°red − E°ox lagayein, phir 2 : 5 : 10 mole ratio istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: Based on the E° values, the MnO₄⁻ ion is more likely to be reduced to Mn²⁺

steps: Reduction: 2 × [MnO₄⁻ + 8H⁺ + 5e⁻ → Mn²⁺ + 4H₂O]; oxidation: 5 × [C₂O₄²⁻ → 2CO₂ + 2e⁻]; dono mein 10 electrons.
blocks.final_answer: E°cell = +2.01 V; KMnO₄ 30.0 cm³; CO₂ 2.40 × 10⁻³ mol.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Is reaction mein book ke chhape hue E° aur multipliers galat hain (book correction boxes). Sahi: E°(2CO₂/C₂O₄²⁻) = −0.49 V, MnO₄⁻ wali half × 2, C₂O₄²⁻ wali × 5, aur E°cell = +2.01 V.

blocks.prompt:
22 Acidified MnO₄⁻ oxidizes Fe²⁺ ions (E°: MnO₄⁻/Mn²⁺ = +1.52 V; Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ = +0.77 V). (i) Write the balanced ionic equation and calculate E°cell. (ii) 25.0 cm³ of an Fe²⁺ solution needs 18.0 cm³ of 0.0200 mol dm⁻³ KMnO₄ in acid. Calculate the concentration of Fe²⁺. (4 marks)
(Acidified MnO₄⁻ Fe²⁺ ions ko oxidize karta hai (E°: MnO₄⁻/Mn²⁺ = +1.52 V; Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ = +0.77 V). (i) Balanced ionic equation likhein aur E°cell nikalein. (ii) 25.0 cm³ Fe²⁺ solution ko acid mein 0.0200 mol dm⁻³ KMnO₄ ke 18.0 cm³ chahiye. Fe²⁺ ka concentration nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: MnO₄⁻ (zyada musbat E°) reduce aur Fe²⁺ oxidize hota hai; 1 MnO₄⁻ 5 electrons leta hai, is liye 5 Fe²⁺ ko oxidize karta hai. Titre se MnO₄⁻ ke moles, 5 se zarab, phir Fe²⁺ ke volume se taqseem.

book_ref.quote: Combine and balance the two equations and sum up their standard electrode potentials

steps: Reduction: MnO₄⁻ + 8H⁺ + 5e⁻ → Mn²⁺ + 4H₂O; oxidation: 5 × [Fe²⁺ → Fe³⁺ + e⁻].

blocks.prompt:
23 Excess KI is added to 25.0 cm³ of 0.100 mol dm⁻³ copper(II) sulphate: 2Cu²⁺(aq) + 4I⁻(aq) → 2CuI(s) + I₂(aq). (i) From E°(Cu²⁺/Cu⁺) = +0.15 V and E°(½I₂/I⁻) = +0.54 V, find the net standard potential and state why the reaction still proceeds. (ii) Calculate the moles of CuI and I₂ formed and of I⁻ used. (4 marks)
(25.0 cm³ 0.100 mol dm⁻³ copper(II) sulphate mein zyada KI dala jata hai: 2Cu²⁺(aq) + 4I⁻(aq) → 2CuI(s) + I₂(aq). (i) E°(Cu²⁺/Cu⁺) = +0.15 V aur E°(½I₂/I⁻) = +0.54 V se net standard potential nikalein aur batayein ke reaction phir bhi kyun hota hai. (ii) Banne wale CuI aur I₂ ke moles aur istemal hone wale I⁻ ke moles nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Cu²⁺ reduce aur I⁻ oxidize hota hai, is liye E° = E°(Cu²⁺/Cu⁺) − E°(I₂/I⁻); phir equation ka 2 : 4 : 2 : 1 mole ratio istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: The reaction is driven forward because CuI formed is continuously precipitating out of the solution

steps: (i) E° = E°red − E°ox = 0.15 − 0.54 = −0.39 V, manfi qeemat.
Phir bhi reaction hota hai: CuI musalsal precipitate hota hai, Cu⁺ hat jata hai aur equilibrium right ko khisakta hai (Le Chatelier's principle).
blocks.final_answer: Net E° = −0.39 V (CuI ke precipitation se reaction chalta hai); CuI 2.50 × 10⁻³ mol, I₂ 1.25 × 10⁻³ mol, I⁻ 5.00 × 10⁻³ mol istemal.
